describes: Estimated current battery configuration: V1.40 frame, V1.41 cap and taped hatch, D-037 bars and battery position, U20CAM with full 1 m lead, head microphones and touch board. CAD/density and prior component estimates; not weighed and not scan-registered. Unshifted screw-mount frame; Dual Lock fitting unconfirmed. Current V1.33 ear cap/jaw support, V1.36 lower shell, U20 face/trim and V1.37 jaw ring recomputed from dated visual source geometry; speaker/amplifier moved to floor, retired collar retainer removed.
position_frame: Each part position is in its named MuJoCo body frame, metres; position_mm on trunk_base is the unshifted guide robot frame, x forward y left z up. No unconfirmed -8.7 mm Dual Lock shift.
excluded: No unconfirmed Dual Lock plate/strips or -8.7 mm mounting shift; four existing pack mounting screws retained.
Saddle lid not fitted; no lid added.
Ordered replacement camera cables are not installed; 1 m existing cable retained.
Full outer-shell and camera extrinsic scan registration remains independent of mass estimation.
NP-F970 90 g removal is applied by apply_masses.variant_parts, not repeated in this parts list.

estimation.method: Preserve prior Claude CAD volume x 1.24 g/cm3 x 0.851 effective solid fraction for printed parts; mesh centre of mass and tensor in unshifted robot frame. Reuse documented component/lead estimates with explicit uncertainty.
estimation.static_pose_evidence: User confirms both new scans were captured powered, under closed-loop control, standing and bending. Joint/IMU synchronization and registration not yet established.
estimation.uncertainty: Printed masses use prior effective density (0.851); examine +/-20%. Cable 10-30 g/m, camera 6-12 g, adapter 1-6 g, tape 0.05-0.6 g. Coiled cable distribution and shell masses/poses require sensitivity checks; no new user weighing needed for this estimated baseline.
estimation.head_reconciliation: All changed printed head pieces replace their legacy add entries, leaving official subtraction entries once. Body transform comes from official zero-pose MuJoCo frames. Speaker and amplifier component masses retained at current mesh centres; obsolete roof retainer and amplifier screws removed; mic/touch estimated masses relocated to current guide centres.
